import numpy as np
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
from control import S,names
J=S['proprio']; jnames=J['joints']; axes=np.array(J['axis']); pos=np.array(J['position_m'])
def rot(ax,a): return Rotation.from_rotvec(np.array(ax)*a).as_matrix()
def fk(q,side='left',point=None):
 ids=[10]+[names.index(side+'_'+j) for j in ['shoulder_pitch','shoulder_roll','shoulder_yaw','elbow','wrist_yaw']]+[21 if side=='left' else 41,22 if side=='left' else 42]
 if point is None: point=[.42,.214 if side=='left' else -.214,.087]
 T=np.eye(4)
 for i in ids:
  name=names[i].replace('_A_','_'); ji=jnames.index(name); ax=axes[ji]; p=pos[ji]; rr=rot(ax,q[i]); tt=p-rr@p
  M=np.eye(4); M[:3,:3]=rr; M[:3,3]=tt; T=T@M
 return T[:3,:3]@np.array(point)+T[:3,3],T[:3,:3]
def ik(q,target,side='left',orientation=None):
 ids=[names.index(side+'_'+j) for j in ['shoulder_pitch','shoulder_roll','shoulder_yaw','elbow','wrist_yaw']]+[21 if side=='left' else 41,22 if side=='left' else 42]
 from control import R
 old=q[ids].copy()
 def loss(x):
  a=q.copy();a[ids]=x;p,rr=fk(a,side)
  out=list((p-target)*10)
  if orientation is not None:out+=list((rr-orientation).flatten()*.3)
  out+=list((x-old)*.02)
  return out
 res=least_squares(loss,old,bounds=(R[ids,0]+1e-5,R[ids,1]-1e-5),max_nfev=300)
 q=q.copy();q[ids]=res.x

 return q
cam=S['cameras']['room_camera']; C=np.array(cam['pose']['position_m']); F=np.array(cam['pose']['forward']); U=np.array(cam['pose']['up']); H=np.array(cam['pose']['right']); foc=128/np.tan(np.deg2rad(cam['fovy_deg']/2))
def ray(u,v,x=.6):

 return C+(x-C[0])/d[0]*d
if __name__=='__main__':
 for name,uv in [('slider',(115,159)),('drawer',(108,134)),('double',(62,106)),('flip',(113,74)),('top',(82,45))]:print(name,ray(*uv))
